Name: Greener Autumn
Author: necrocandy
Description:
I couldn't stand just how orange and yellow Autumn is. Here, in the Northeast, grass stays pretty green with the occasional spot of yellow dead grass...

So I re-colored the grass to a more muted green and darker dirt. There is still bits of the yellow grass near buildings because I wanted to keep some of it. 

This is my first edit, and I hope I got most of it right, although when the wind blows one graphic switches to the yellow shadow,
but I cannot get it to work otherwise.

Also the mushrooms I added bob and I don't know if the original ones did, but these ones do and I liked it and kept it.

Updated [5/24] Fixed some stray pixels that changed near the water,
it's not 100% fixed and there are still some issues but it's a lot better than before X3
